title: Patch: standardize spelling to American English
thread:
**Issue #2445 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #2445: Patch: standardize spelling to American English
Opened by @MaxGoetzmann.

## What and why

The repository mixes British and American spelling. A rough `git grep -il` count over the tree finds `colour` in ~170 files, `behaviour` ~114, `centre` ~144, `serialis*` ~300, `labelled` ~168, `cancelled` ~229, plus `honour`, `favour`, `armour`, `normalis*`, `recognis*`, `optimis*`, `licence`, `defence`, `catalogue`, `organisation`, `modelled`, `travelled`. Standardize on American English (`color`, `behavior`, `center`, `serialize`, `labeled`, `canceled`, `honor`, `favor`, `armor`, `normalize`, `recognize`, `optimize`, `license`, `defense`, `catalog`, `organization`, `modeled`, `traveled`) so prose, comments and UI read the same way throughout.

Low priority: it changes how the text reads, not how the game behaves.

## Scope

**In:** prose and comments in `spec/`, `BUILD.md`, `REVIEW.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `docs/`, the crate and app READMEs, code comments, test names and messages, and player-facing English strings in `apps/web` (the English locale, not other languages' text). Internal identifiers that nothing outside the codebase reads (local variables, private fns, CSS classes, constants such as `PLANET_COLOURS`) may be renamed too.

**Out: leave these as they are**
- **Anything persisted or on the wire**: serde field names, JSON keys, `catalog.json` / `flavour.json` / `patches.json` keys, the server API's fields (e.g. `favouriteCards` in `crates/server` and `apps/web/src/net/api.ts`), database columns and migrations, `localStorage` keys, golden traces and replays, routes. Renaming one breaks saved data, old replays or a deployed client (CLAUDE.md rule 13). If renaming one seems worth it, open a separate issue.
- **File names** read by builds or tools (e.g. `crates/cards/flavour.json`, read by `build.rs`).
- **History**: shipped patch notes in `crates/cards/patches/`, `reviews/`, commit messages, and the designer's source notes (`JackiOh_*.md`, `ARCHITECTURE-CCG.md`, `docs/*-set*.md`), which REVIEW Part A checks the spec against.
- **Bot-forbidden paths** (`.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`): the harness reverts changes there. Note what's left in those paths in the PR so a person can follow up.
- Words that are already American or correct in both spellings (`analysis`, `fulfill` vs. `fulfil` is in scope, `canceled` is in scope).

## Notes for the builder

- If a card's words or flavour text change, it's wording-only (micro tier). Run `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` and add a pending fragment with `cargo jackioh patches` if the classifier asks for one.
- Changing ruling notes' prose is fine. Don't change any R-id, `proven_in` path, or test name a ruling's `spec check` depends on unless both sides are updated together.
- Generated files (`apps/web/src/wire/*.ts`, `crates/cards/luau/jackioh.luau`) come from their generators. Change the source, then regenerate them.
- It touches many shared files, so a split ([fullsend](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/main/bot/README.md#fullsend)) by area (docs+spec, crates, apps/web+e2e) should help avoid conflicts.

## Acceptance

- `git grep -iE "colour|behaviour|centre|honour|favour|armour|serialis|normalis|recognis|optimis|licence|defence|catalogue|organis|labelled|cancelled|modelled|travelled"` finds only the excluded categories above. The PR lists what's left and why.
- Every required check is green: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` (no diff to `apps/web/src/wire/` beyond what's committed), `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh patches check`, `cargo jackioh golden check`, `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test`, `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e`, and the e2e smoke.
- No wire, DB, catalog key or golden trace changes.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-1` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41002025579)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

**Goal.** Every British spelling the issue names (and its -ing/-s/-ed forms) reads American in prose, comments, test names and messages, internal identifiers and the English UI, across `spec/`, the root docs, `docs/`, READMEs, `crates/`, `apps/web`, `e2e`, `training/`, `analysis/` and `scripts/` comments. Nothing persisted, on the wire, hashed or pinned changes. Excluded paths stay as they are, and every check stays green. The acceptance grep then finds only the excluded categories, which the builder's report lists.

**Files to touch**

| Path | Kind | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `/tmp/americanize.py` | new, outside the repo, never committed | the one-off script of step 1 |
| about 903 tracked files the script selects (at base: `spec/` ~85, `docs/` ~20, `BUILD.md`, `REVIEW.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `CONTRIBUTING.md`, `README.md`, `Cargo.toml` comments, `crates/*` ~455, `apps/web` ~335, `e2e` ~30, `training/`, `analysis/`, `scripts/*.sh` comments) | change | the stems are replaced inside words, with case kept (`PLANET_COLOURS`→`PLANET_COLORS`, `CANCELLED_MEMORY_KEY`→`CANCELED_MEMORY_KEY`, `LethalHitTo::Cancelled`→`Canceled`, `--drag-reticle-colour`, `jk-cross-centre`, test names) |
| `apps/web/src/i18n/zh-CN.json` | change (the script) | five English keys follow their renamed sentences; the Chinese values are untouched |
| `crates/cards/flavour.json` | change (the script) | seven flavour lines; "plot armour" and "Armour-piercing" stay |
| `apps/web/src/wire/generated/{AnnounceRecord,CardCost,CardDef,CardMark,CardView,ControlHow,GameEvent,LoadoutResult,PerPlayer,PerTeam,SideView}.ts` | regenerated | doc comments only |
| `crates/ai/tests/ai/match_refusal.rs` | `cargo fmt` | one line re-wrapped after the rename |
| `apps/web/src/writing.test.ts` | change | `BRITISH` constant and one `it` (step 6) |
| `apps/web/WRITING.md` | change | one bullet under "Consistent" |
| `CONTRIBUTING.md` | change | one bullet under "Pull requests and commits" |

Do not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, `.claude/`, `reviews/`, `crates/cards/patches/`, `crates/cards/catalog.json` (it has no stem), `JackiOh_*.md`, `ARCHITECTURE-CCG.md`, `docs/{classic-sets,meditative-set,meditative-plus-set,stinkyscape-set,training-grounds-set}.md`, `crates/server/migrations/` (its checksums are pinned in `tests/store/migrations_pinned.rs`), `spec/INDEX.md` (`spec fold` rewrites it daily from the notes' titles), `crates/engine/tests/golden/` and `apps/web/src/cards/art/fixtures/`. Do not hand-edit `apps/web/src/wire/generated/`, `engineConfig.ts`, `serverConfig.ts` or `crates/cards/luau/jackioh.luau`. No file is renamed. No ruling, R-id, `proven_in` path, pending fragment, `spec/pending/` file or `RELEASES` line is added. CLAUDE.md rules 3 (R-ids and test tokens stay), 7, 9 and 13 govern this change, and no spec section changes meaning.

**Steps**

1. Run `git status --porcelain`; it must print nothing. Create `/tmp/americanize.py` with exactly this content:

```python
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""#2445: British -> American spelling, run once from the repository root. Not committed."""
import re
import subprocess

STEMS = [
    ("centred", "centered"), ("centring", "centering"), ("centre", "center"),
    ("colour", "color"), ("behaviour", "behavior"), ("honour", "honor"), ("favour", "favor"),
    ("armour", "armor"), ("serialis(?=[eai])", "serializ"), ("normalis(?=[eai])", "normaliz"),
    ("recognis(?=[eai])", "recogniz"), ("optimis(?=[eai])", "optimiz"), ("organis(?=[eai])", "organiz"),
    ("licence", "license"), ("defence", "defense"),
    ("catalogued", "cataloged"), ("catalogues", "catalogs"), ("catalogue", "catalog"),
    ("labelled", "labeled"), ("labelling", "labeling"), ("cancelled", "canceled"),
    ("cancelling", "canceling"), ("modelled", "modeled"), ("modelling", "modeling"),
    ("travelled", "traveled"), ("travelling", "traveling"),
]
STEM = re.compile("|".join(f"({b})" for b, _ in STEMS), re.I)
TOKEN = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]+")

EXCLUDE = re.compile(
    r"^(\.github/|\.harness/|\.squishy/|bot/|\.claude/|reviews/|crates/cards/patches/"
    r"|JackiOh_[^/]*\.md$|ARCHITECTURE-CCG\.md$"
    r"|docs/(classic-sets|meditative-set|meditative-plus-set|stinkyscape-set|training-grounds-set)\.md$"
    r"|crates/server/migrations/|spec/INDEX\.md$|crates/engine/tests/golden/"
    r"|apps/web/src/wire/generated/|apps/web/src/wire/(engine|server)Config\.ts$"
    r"|crates/cards/luau/jackioh\.luau$|apps/web/src/cards/art/fixtures/)"
)

# Wire, persisted or external names.
KEEP_TOKENS = {
    "labelledby",  # aria-labelledby
    "AttackCancelled", "attackCancelled", "attack_cancelled", "ATTACK_CANCELLED",  # event
    "StarscapeTravelled", "starscapeTravelled", "starscape_travelled",  # event
    "travelled_on", "travelledOn",  # StarscapeMap field, hashed state
    "cancelledTurn",  # CANCELLED_MEMORY_KEY's value, in a card's memory
    "favouriteCards", "favourite_cards",  # server API field
    "is_cancelled",  # tokio's JoinError::is_cancelled
}

# RNG seeds, pinned art and voice inputs, card data, and flavour where "Armor" is a banned word.
KEEP_TEXT = [
    '"dc-after-cancelled"', '"ally-cancelled"', '"dc-when-cancelled"', '"r125-armour"',
    '"cancelled-room"', '"centre", "left"', "centre: { from: 44", '"armour*"',
    "labelled trees", "Subscription cancelled.", "plot armour", "Armour-piercing",
]

# Bare `cancelled` is a wire name (JSON key or value, DB status, serialized field, GitHub
# conclusion) after a quote, backtick or dot (in prose also a brace), or before a colon in code
# that is not a comment, `let` or `const`. Never in WIRE_FREE.
WIRE_BEFORE = "`\"'."
WIRE_AFTER = re.compile(r"\s*:(?!:)")
LOCAL = re.compile(r"\b(let|let mut|const|var)\s+$")
WIRE_FREE = ("apps/web/src/audio/", "apps/web/src/cards/fit.ts", "apps/web/src/replay/")
COMMENT = re.compile(r"\s*(//|/\*|\*|--|#(?!\[))")
CODE = (".rs", ".ts", ".tsx", ".js", ".mjs", ".sql", ".py")


def american(match):
    i = next(n for n, g in enumerate(match.groups()) if g is not None)
    text, out = match.group(0), STEMS[i][1]
    if text.isupper():
        return out.upper()
    return out[0].upper() + out[1:] if text[0].isupper() else out


def fix_line(path, line):
    if not STEM.search(line):
        return line
    kept = [text for text in KEEP_TEXT if text in line]
    for i, text in enumerate(kept):
        line = line.replace(text, f"\0{i}\0")
    code = path.endswith(CODE) and not COMMENT.match(line)

    def fix_token(match):
        token = match.group(0)
        if token in KEEP_TOKENS:
            return token
        if token == "cancelled" and not path.startswith(WIRE_FREE):
            before = line[match.start() - 1] if match.start() else " "
            if before in WIRE_BEFORE or (before == "{" and not path.endswith(CODE)):
                return token
            if code and WIRE_AFTER.match(line, match.end()) and not LOCAL.search(line, 0, match.start()):
                return token
        return STEM.sub(american, token)

    line = TOKEN.sub(fix_token, line)
    for i, text in enumerate(kept):
        line = line.replace(f"\0{i}\0", text)
    return line


changed = 0
for path in subprocess.run(["git", "ls-files"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.splitlines():
    if EXCLUDE.match(path):
        continue
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
            text = f.read()
    except (UnicodeDecodeError, IsADirectoryError, FileNotFoundError):
        continue
    if not STEM.search(text):
        continue
    out = "".join(fix_line(path, line) for line in text.splitlines(keepends=True))
    if out != text:
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
            f.write(out)
        changed += 1
print(f"americanize: {changed} files changed")
```

2. From the repository root, run `python3 -I /tmp/americanize.py`. At base 07fef3cf1 it prints `americanize: 903 files changed`; on a newer `main` the count may differ slightly. Do not edit any file before this step. The script keys on content, not line numbers, so it can run again on a newer `main`.
3. Run `cargo fmt`. At base, it re-wraps only `crates/ai/tests/ai/match_refusal.rs`.
4. Regenerate: `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features ts export_bindings`, `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features ts --test export_config`, `cargo test -p jackioh-luau --features ts --test export_api`. Then run this check, which must print `… 0 outside comments: []`:

```sh
python3 -I - <<'EOF'
import re, subprocess
files = subprocess.run(["git", "diff", "--name-only", "--", "apps/web/src/wire/generated", "crates/cards/luau/jackioh.luau"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout.split()
strip = lambda s: re.sub(r"/\*.*?\*/|//[^\n]*|--[^\n]*", "", s, flags=re.S)
bad = [f for f in files if strip(subprocess.run(["git", "show", f"HEAD:{f}"], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout) != strip(open(f, encoding="utf-8").read())]
print(f"{len(files)} generated files changed, {len(bad)} outside comments: {bad}")
EOF
```
At base it reports 11 files, and `jackioh.luau` stays unchanged. A file listed in `bad` means a serialized name changed. Find its Rust source, add the token to `KEEP_TOKENS`, `git checkout -- .`, and start again at step 2.
5. `apps/web/WRITING.md`, section "## Consistent": after the bullet starting "- When something fails", add `- American spelling: color, behavior, center, favorite, canceled, labeled.` In `CONTRIBUTING.md`, section "## Pull requests and commits", add this as the last bullet: `- Write American English (color, behavior, center, canceled, serialize) in prose, comments, test names and the client's words. A name on the wire or in storage keeps the spelling it shipped with; rename one only in an issue of its own (#2445).` Neither line may contain a British form.
6. In `apps/web/src/writing.test.ts`, below the `MARKS` constant, add:

```ts
/** WRITING.md, Consistent: American spelling (#2445). "optimism" and "optimistic" are American too. */
const BRITISH =
  /colour|behaviour|centre|honour|favour|armour|licence|defence|catalogue|labell(ed|ing)|cancell(ed|ing)|modell(ed|ing)|travell(ed|ing)|(serial|normal|recogn|optim|organ)is[eai]/i;
```
Inside `describe("WRITING.md the client's words for players", …)`, after the curly-apostrophe `it`, add:

```ts
  it("no sentence the client shows a player and no dictionary key spells a word the British way", () => {
    const found = playerTexts()
      .filter(({ text }) => BRITISH.test(text))
      .map(({ at, text }) => `${at}: ${JSON.stringify(text)}`)
      .sort();
    expect(found).toEqual([]);
    expect(Object.keys(zhCN).filter((key) => BRITISH.test(key))).toEqual([]);
    expect(BRITISH.test("Room cancelled. Its code no longer works.")).toBe(true);
    expect(BRITISH.test("Favourite card")).toBe(true);
    expect(BRITISH.test("Room canceled. Its code no longer works.")).toBe(false);
    expect(BRITISH.test("Read that edge as optimistic.")).toBe(false);
  });
```
7. Run the checks under **Tests**, and fix any fallout by hand in the same style. If a failure is a kept name that got renamed, revert that rename and add the name to `KEEP_TOKENS` or `KEEP_TEXT` in your report.
8. Run the leftover grep (under **Done when**). Every line it prints must be a kept case: a `KEEP_TOKENS` or `KEEP_TEXT` entry, a bare wire `cancelled`, or "optimism"/"optimistic". At base that comes to about 115 lines in 38 files. In the final report, list what stays and why, grouped by reason: wire or persisted names, `aria-labelledby`, pinned or hashed inputs, RNG seeds, card data, the two flavour lines, excluded paths (naming the forbidden-path files, for a person: 25 in `.github/`, 45 in `bot/`, `.harness/trust.txt`, `.claude/skills/fullsend/agents/builder.md`) and `spec/INDEX.md` until the next `spec fold`.

**Tests**

- `apps/web/src/writing.test.ts`, the new `it("no sentence the client shows a player and no dictionary key spells a word the British way")`: it fails at base on the five zh-CN keys ("Room cancelled…", "Favourite card", …) and passes once they are renamed. Run it with `pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/writing.test.ts`.
- Renamed Rust and TypeScript tests keep their R-id tokens. The existing suites prove nothing moved: `cargo test --workspace --features jackioh-engine/testkit,jackioh-engine/ts` (golden replay included), `pnpm --dir apps/web test` (all of it, since ~335 web files change; `i18n.test.ts` R711000 holds the zh-CN keys to the `t()` sentences, `static-pages.test.ts` holds `accessibility.tsx` and `static-pages.ts` together, `flavour.test.tsx` holds the banned words, `motifs.test.ts` holds the pinned art).
- Also run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo jackioh catalog check`, `cargo jackioh patches check`, `cargo jackioh spec check`, `cargo jackioh golden check`, `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` (it must ask for no fragment: card scripts change only in comments and tests), `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web e2e`. If the training deps are installed, run `cd training/ml && python3 -m pytest tests/test_fit.py`. If Docker is there, run `sh crates/server/tests/sql/run.sh`.

**Done when**

- [ ] Steps 2–6 are done, and step 4's check prints `0 outside comments`.
- [ ] Every command under **Tests** passes. After the workspace test, `git status --porcelain -- apps/web/src/wire` lists only the regenerated files and `apps/web/src/wire/catalog.ts`.
- [ ] Leftover grep: only kept cases remain:
```sh
git grep -nIiE "colour|behaviour|centre|honour|favour|armour|serialis|normalis|recognis|optimis|licence|defence|catalogue|organis|labelled|cancelled|modelled|travelled" -- . ':!.github' ':!.harness' ':!.squishy' ':!bot' ':!.claude' ':!reviews' ':!crates/cards/patches' ':!JackiOh_*' ':!ARCHITECTURE-CCG.md' ':!docs/*-set*.md' ':!crates/server/migrations' ':!spec/INDEX.md' ':!apps/web/src/wire/generated' ':!crates/cards/luau/jackioh.luau' ':!apps/web/src/cards/art/fixtures' | grep -vE "labelledby|ttack_?[Cc]ancelled|tarscape_?[Tt]ravelled|ravelled_?[Oo]n|avourite_?[Cc]ards|is_cancelled|cancelledTurn|optimis[mt]"
```
- [ ] `git diff --stat -- crates/server/migrations crates/cards/catalog.json crates/cards/patches crates/engine/tests/golden apps/web/src/cards/art/fixtures .github bot .harness .squishy .claude` prints nothing.
- [ ] The report lists the leftovers (step 8) and the decisions below.

Decisions taken (each with the alternative rejected): the inflections labelling, cancelling, modelling, travelling and centring are in scope, because "canceled" beside "cancelling" reads mixed. Internal names are renamed, not left. Fixture ids `cb-armoured` and `rb-armoured` become `armored` (no trace records them, and their sort order holds), while RNG seed strings stay because a new seed reshuffles the deal. `spec/INDEX.md` is not hand-edited, because the fold would conflict with it. There is no `RELEASES` technical line and no fragment, since no card data ships. "flavour" is left alone, because the issue keeps `flavour.json` and itself writes "flavour".

**Risks**

- A wire or persisted name renamed: protected tokens cover these. Step 4 proves the serialized types unchanged, the golden replay and the server suites prove behavior, and the `db` job proves SQL. A planner dry run of steps 1–4 on a copy at base passed `cargo check --workspace --all-targets` (testkit, ts). It generated only comment changes, and passed the engine's golden, `rules` and `rules_2` tests and all of `cargo test -p jackioh-server`. The web suites were not run then.
- Determinism: no seed, memory key, event name or state field changes. Engine identifier renames touch play code, which `classify` stage 2 replays and should find identical.
- Rust shorthand or format captures (`{cancelled}`) break only at compile time, so clippy and the tests catch them.
- Merge conflicts: the change touches ~900 files. If the merge queue or `main` conflicts, take `main`'s side and run steps 2–4 again; the script is idempotent.
- `aria-labelledby`, `optimistic`, GitHub's `cancelled` and tokio's `is_cancelled` are external names and must stay.

**Open questions**

- Other British forms are outside the issue's list and left alone: grey (~94 files), judgement (~40), finalis* (~47), analys* (~31), capitalis* (~20), authoris* (~15), customis* (~11), synchronis*/summaris* (5 each), programme (4) and "flavour" itself. A person decides whether a follow-up issue takes them.
- What is left in bot-forbidden paths needs a person: comments and templates in `.github/` (GitHub's `cancelled()` and run conclusion there must stay), `bot/`, `.harness/trust.txt` and `.claude/skills/fullsend/agents/builder.md`.
- Wire names left British (`favouriteCards`, `attackCancelled`, `starscapeTravelled`, `travelledOn`, `DeclaredAttack.cancelled`, `"cancelledTurn"`, the `cancelled` JSON key and ticket/challenge status, `room.cancelled` log events): renaming any of them needs its own issue with a compatibility plan (a serde alias, a migration, old replays).
- The voice line "Subscription cancelled." stays: re-rendering it needs macOS `say`, since its hash is in `voice-manifest.json`. The two "armour" flavour lines stay because "Armor" is in `BANNED_RULES_WORDS`. A person may reword them.
- One pull request (recommended, since the script is atomic and re-runnable) or a fullsend split by area, as the issue suggests: a person's call. `difficulty:hard` fits (~900 files).
````

```python
    ("colour", "color"), ("behaviour", "behavior"), ("honour", "honor"), ("favour", "favor"),

    ("cancelling", "canceling"), ("modelled", "modeled"), ("modelling", "modeling"),
    ("travelled", "traveled"), ("travelling", "traveling"),
]
STEM = re.compile("|".join(f"({b})" for b, _ in STEMS), re.I)
TOKEN = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]+")

EXCLUDE = re.compile(
    r"^(\.github/|\.harness/|\.squishy/|bot/|\.claude/|reviews/|crates/cards/patches/"

)

    "AttackCancelled", "attackCancelled", "attack_cancelled", "ATTACK_CANCELLED",  # event
    "StarscapeTravelled", "starscapeTravelled", "starscape_travelled",  # event
    "travelled_on", "travelledOn",  # StarscapeMap field, hashed state

    "favouriteCards", "favourite_cards",  # server API field
    "is_cancelled",  # tokio's JoinError::is_cancelled
}

# conclusion) after a quote, backtick or dot (in prose also a brace), or before a colon in code
# that is not a comment, `let` or `const`. Never in WIRE_FREE.

WIRE_AFTER = re.compile(r"\s*:(?!:)")
LOCAL = re.compile(r"\b(let|let mut|const|var)\s+$")
WIRE_FREE = ("apps/web/src/audio/", "apps/web/src/cards/fit.ts", "apps/web/src/replay/")
COMMENT = re.compile(r"\s*(//|/\*|\*|--|#(?!\[))")

def american(match):
    i = next(n for n, g in enumerate(match.groups()) if g is not None)
    text, out = match.group(0), STEMS[i][1]
    if text.isupper():
        return out.upper()
    return out[0].upper() + out[1:] if text[0].isupper() else out


def fix_line(path, line):
    if not STEM.search(line):
        return line
    kept = [text for text in KEEP_TEXT if text in line]
    for i, text in enumerate(kept):

    code = path.endswith(CODE) and not COMMENT.match(line)
```

````markdown
    ("cancelling", "canceling"), ("modelled", "modeled"), ("modelling", "modeling"),
    ("travelled", "traveled"), ("travelling", "traveling"),
]

TOKEN = re.compile(r"[A-Za-z0-9_]+")

EXCLUDE = re.compile(

    "favouriteCards", "favourite_cards",  # server API field
    "is_cancelled",  # tokio's JoinError::is_cancelled
}
````
